title: Appeal 45/3/162: cow byre converted to office use; relaxation of Requirements K1 and M2 refused
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2000 (as amended): Requirements K1 (stairs, ladders and ramps) and M2 (access and use)

facts.text: The building work comprises material alterations to a disused cow byre within the clients' property, to convert it to an office or study with kitchen and toilet facilities.
The appeal is against the District Council's refusal to relax or dispense with Requirement K1 and Requirement M2.
The Secretary of State considers a ramp between the two ground-floor levels is not required to comply with Requirement M2, although the two steps should meet acceptable ambulant standards.
On K1, the Secretary of State concludes it would not be appropriate to relax the stair requirement to permit ladders or steps, given the carrying of items for storage.
Determination: the appeal is dismissed in respect of the refusal to relax or dispense with Requirements M2 and K1.
